name: Live Kree or Die!, 3 of 4: Blue Moon

synopsis.text: Live Kree or Die tie-in! Quicksilver joins an elite team of Avengers to thwart a Kree attack from Earth’s moon. The Kree have targeted an Omni-wave projector at our planet, set to decimate at any moment. With time of the essence, Quicksilver may be the speedy recovery this mission needs!
